comment: Effective-dated tariff rows (ADR-0016 section 4, CAP-MODEL-05). USD per 1M tokens as decimal strings. Only numbers that appear in the verified capability register (docs/capabilities/register.json, verified 2026-10-22) or, for Anthropic, in the Claude API reference model table supplied by the coordinator are recorded; every other rate is null and every band whose rule is not recorded is 'unverified', so cost()/worst_case() refuse instead of guessing. Only rows with approved_by set are admissible (worst_case refuses the rest until the owner re-verifies a row against the provider pricing page and sets approved_by); as of 2026-10-22 only anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 is approved, under the owner's USD 200 authorization. effective_from is the first date this system relies on the observation (the true start date is not recorded).

band.note: Short context: <=272K input tokens (pricing page). 272K read as 272,000; any reading of K puts <=272,000 in this band.

cache_write.note: Register: writes 1.25x (30m default) / 2.5x (12h) on GPT-5.6 and later (close paraphrase). Applicability to this id is inferred, so cost() refuses write tokens; worst_case() uses the multipliers as an upper bound.

rows.note: Table row '| gpt-6.1-sol | $2.00 | $10.00 | $0.10 |'; cached read 0.05x of input on GPT-6.1 Sol per the caching guide (0.05 x 2.00 = 0.10).

band.note: Long context (>272K input tokens) has separate prices on the pricing page that the register does not record, and whether they apply to every token of the request is an open question (CAP-MODEL-05).

cache_write.note: Same multipliers as above; applicability inferred.

At or above the 200k threshold under either reading of k: 'requests whose prompt reaches the listed token threshold are billed at the higher rate for all tokens in the request.'

cache_write.note: Register CAP-MODEL-05 and the API reference both give 5m 1.25x / 1h 2x of the input rate. Verified 2026-10-24 against the claude-api skill's prompt-caching reference ('Cache writes cost 1.25x for 5-minute TTL, 2x for 1-hour TTL'; cache reads 0.05x on Claude Opus 5.5) so that the AI analyst, which caches its system prompt and tool definitions with the 5-minute TTL, settles cache writes exactly. The research adapter still sends no cache_control.
